about_the_game:
Supporter Pack is a bundle for those who want to support the development of Spaceport Trading Company.

As a token of our gratitude, you will receive:
  • The ability to change the color of Engine Trails
  • A hat for your ship
  • First access to new music. We are working on expanding the music in the game and will be presenting the new track here first.


Thank you for your support!
